lines.en: My long tail swings behind me.
I break into a jog, claws gripping the dirt.

lines.zh: 我弓着背走过林间空地。
lines.en: I walk hunched across a forest clearing.
I sniff the ground and walk on slowly.
I go around a clump of ferns.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾张开，落得很轻。
lines.en: My toes spread and settle lightly.
I stop and let my tail level out.
The creek bank is soft; I go slower.

lines.zh: 我沿着树根的地势往上走。
lines.en: I follow the lie of the roots uphill.

lines.zh: 羽毛盖着的前肢挠了挠。
lines.en: My feathered forelimb scratches at me.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看树上的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head at something in the tree.
My tail tip sways gently.
I open my mouth and breathe out.

lines.zh: 我在晒太阳，慢慢暖起来。
lines.en: I bask and slowly warm up.
My tail sways little by little.
There's a sheen on my scales.
My neck feathers puff up and settle.
I half close my eyes, quite at ease.
I put my snout to the soil.
I haven't moved in a while.
My claws hold onto a root.
I swallow slowly.
You stand there, and I look at you.
I'm not sure I should make way.

lines.zh: 你的手比我整个头还小。
lines.en: Your hand is smaller than my whole head.
I catch your scent.
You weren't in this area before.
Reach out and I'll peck.
I don't know if you're afraid of me.
I'd rather keep some distance.
Walk away and I'll go back to grazing.
It swayed, then straightened again.
A white line on my scales.
My tail feathers sweep a tuft of grass down.

lines.zh: 背上秃了一小块，露着皮。
lines.en: A bald patch on my back shows skin.
I looked down, then up again.
My two hind legs hold me up.
That hit my flank.
My tail has sagged down.
Half of this skeleton looks like a chicken.
No meat for me; I want tender leaves.
You hold it up; I take a step back.
That doesn't look right.
I'd rather eat leaves.
Just leave it on the ground.
That's very strange.
My mouth was made for plants.
Holding that is dangerous.

lines.zh: 我从来不吃人给的东西。
lines.en: I never eat what people offer.
You bump my flank.
One turn and I'm clear.
My tail catches you.
Your boot landed on my toes.
My claws grip the dirt and don't slip.
Both sides took a dull thud.
My body isn't as hard as yours.
I pull my leg free slowly.
There's another one at the far end of the wood.
We each graze our own patch.
It stands a notch shorter beside me.

lines.zh: 我们靠得很近，没有冲突。
lines.en: We keep close without any trouble.
It answered with a low call.

lines.zh: 我们并排走过一段林子。
lines.en: We walked a stretch of wood side by side.
There's an old mark on its tail.
We keep to the same group.
It left first; I stayed.
I dip my head and take a leaf.

lines.zh: 鸡龙的喙磕了两下，挑开了。
lines.en: Two knocks of the beak, and I flick it aside.
I push the branches aside with a claw.

lines.zh: 我把它甩到一边，短翅膀甩得很费劲。
lines.en: I fling it aside; these short wings strain.
There's a tough root on the ground.
I chew it twice, slowly.
Two knocks of my beak and it won't break.
I have no interest in this at all.

lines.zh: 鸡一样的龙，只在机器里孵。
lines.en: A chicken-like dragon hatched only in machines.
I sniff it and leave it.
Something moved over there.

lines.zh: 我这副小骨架，是孵出来的。
lines.en: This little frame was hatched in a machine.
At this distance I could run.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我回林子的路。
lines.en: You're between me and the wood.
My beak nearly touches the ground.
My tail has lifted.
You chase one step; I back off three.
I've decided not to back off.
You had better not come any further.
I'm sinking lower.
This time I won't run.
The soil grips my toes.
If you're going to, come on.

lines.zh: 我留了一个能跑的角度。
lines.en: I've kept an angle open for running.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴替我保持平衡。
lines.en: My tail keeps my balance.
Your scent stays on this side.
I'm looking for gaps between the roots.
You go around; I turn too.
You're faster than me. I know.
I keep checking behind me.
The wood is close; I can get in.
You halt, and I halt.
I stay low, ready to break into a run.
I'm running low on strength.

lines.zh: 追你之前，我先咬一口草。
lines.en: Before I chase, I take one bite of grass.

lines.zh: 我把头压到肩膀那么低。
lines.en: I lower my head to shoulder height.
You are too close to that fern patch.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被围住的感觉。
lines.en: I do not like feeling boxed in.
I drive my head forward.
You back off; I back off at once.
I look like a chicken. I run like a dinosaur.

lines.zh: 鸡一样的脖子甩了过去。
lines.en: My chicken-like neck swings at you.
My teeth aren't sharp.
Now you should make way.
I hit your leg and bounce back.
I turn and run.
My feet slipped.
I want to get back into the wood.

lines.zh: 我弓着背，从树后走进空地。
lines.en: Hunched, I walk out from behind the tree.
The grass in this wood is thick.
First I take two bites of grass.
My head comes up to scan the area.
Wind comes through the trees.
My tail sweeps a fern.
I hear another one call.
It's quiet here. I like it.
My first look is upward.

lines.zh: 我选了条朝水边的方向。
lines.en: I choose a direction toward water.
My shadow has only just settled.
I'm a little hungry.
The sun lands nicely on my back.
Fire sears and I back away.

lines.zh: 我从坡上摔下去，翻了一圈。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope.
Water up my snout; I choke.
The blast pushed me across the whole meadow.
A light stops me moving.

lines.zh: 草太少了，我越来越没力。
lines.en: Too little grass; I'm losing strength.

lines.zh: 这里没有地，我踩不到任何东西。
lines.en: No ground here; nothing under my feet.
